segments.name: hotel
segments.description: Owns premium-branded, focused-service and compact full-service hotels and rents rooms and sells food and beverage to guests.
segments.evidence: However, because each of the hotels has similar economic characteristics, facilities, and services, the hotel properties have been aggregated into a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Hotel customers pay for rooms, food and beverage, parking, resort fees, gift shop purchases and other guest services at the company's hotels.
revenueModel.evidence: The hotel segment generates room revenue by renting hotel rooms to customers at the Company's hotel properties.
